prompts.ryu: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: transparent sprite atlas for existing pixel-art fighting game. Reference is exact CHARACTER IDENTITY and ART STYLE only. Create a new 4 columns by 4 rows atlas (16 equal square cells) of ONLY this same fighter facing RIGHT in all cells. Preserve face, hairstyle, costume, colors, proportions and detailed arcade anime pixel shading. Profile: ninja: quick shin kick, long side kick, crouching sweep, shoulder toss. ROW 1: light kick four frames: guarded knee chamber, half extension, fully extended low kick, retraction. ROW 2: heavy kick four frames: windup, half extension, fully extended long kick, retraction. ROW 3: crouching low kick four frames: crouch chamber, low extension, extended sweep, retraction. ROW 4: throw attacker four frames: reach both hands forward, grip imaginary opponent, lift imaginary opponent, follow-through toss. Do not draw the opponent. Grounded supporting foot at identical baseline at 90% of each cell, support foot horizontally at cell center. Constant body scale in all16 cells; no touching other cells; 10% transparent gutters. All 16 poses unique and complete, no captions, no grids, no backgrounds, no decorative effects, true alpha transparency.
